contract.instructions: Create scripts/ranking-lofo-folds.mjs (new file) with the LOFO fold builder per §6.6. §7.6 A9 RED row: test 'related_repository_families_never_cross_fold_boundary'; expected failure: related families split between train and excluded fold; minimal passing: family grouping remains atomic. Family authority: R1.3's LOFO_FAMILIES.json derived from the already-sealed cross-repository-v3 tuning partition and its family mapping (NOT the future C5 tuning manifest, §7.2:1645-1651). Verified at base: evals/search-ranking/cross-repository-v3.manifest.json has 50 tuning tasks / 51 held-out tasks (101 total), with leakage.tuningOnlyRepositoryFamilies listing 11 tuning-only repository families; repositories carry a 'family' field (e.g. gitnexus-r0 -> family gitnexus, split tuning). Note: the plan states six exact LOFO family IDs while the base manifest lists 11 tuning-only repository families — the six-family grouping is sealed by R1.3 and is not independently verifiable at round_base; the builder must consume the sealed LOFO_FAMILIES.json rather than hardcode a count. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A9 row, node --test without tsx) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (root package.json:26) and must stay green.
